tips.li: A week of austerity, from the Decrees page, brings standards back down so the council's rewards count again.
Hard times lower standards on their own, and so does skipping the next feast.
Spoiled colonists ask more often and for more. Grant fewer, bigger wishes.
Granting a bitter colonist's wish, or keeping a promise to them, is the fastest way back.
A decree they love builds trust every day it holds; one they hate wears it down.
Bitter colonists work slower and break sooner. It shows in their Health tab as a grudge against the council.
